label: TypeScript (Node)
note: Strictly compiled TypeScript applications run as retained JavaScript on Node/V8 with tiered compilation and tracing GC. Samples include process startup, JavaScript loading, JIT, input/output and shutdown. Authored TypeScript is counted; emitted JavaScript is retained execution evidence.
classification_basis: The exact native AST and strict compilation establish authored static types; retained applications use imperative loops, classes and function values. V8 bytecode and entered optimized code are recorded in the saved work captures.
memory_policy: Retained Node/V8 defaults; no custom heap or collector flags. A separate sampled process-group RSS limit is 10 GiB.
execution_scope: JIT identifies V8 execution mode. Individual functions can remain interpreted or in baseline code; no warmup or extra main invocation precedes the sample.
compilation_outside_timer: Strict TypeScript source compilation to retained CommonJS JavaScript and source maps
compilation_inside_timer: V8 tiered runtime compilation within each fresh Node process
runtime_evidence_scope: Exact retained application modules and Node binary identity, recorded embedded versions, static Mach-O declared system dependencies and host OS build. System framework/cache contents are identified by OS build; this is not a live mapped-image enumeration or a reproducible binary build proof.
